name: plugin.symbolic_solver
description: Neuro-symbolic constraint solver, logic deduction, and safe arithmetic evaluation

entrypoints.name: solve_constraints
entrypoints.description: Find satisfiable assignments for variables given mathematical and logical constraints

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: List of variable definitions ({name, min, max, type})

parameters.name: constraints
parameters.description: List of constraint expressions as strings (e.g. 'x + y == 10', 'x > 2')

entrypoints.name: verify_logic_query
entrypoints.description: Perform logical deduction over a set of facts and inference rules

parameters.name: facts
parameters.description: List of known ground facts (e.g. 'parent(alice, bob)')

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: List of deduction rules (e.g. 'ancestor(X, Y) :- parent(X, Y)')

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Query to prove or evaluate (e.g. 'parent(alice, bob)')

entrypoints.name: evaluate_math_expression
entrypoints.description: Safely parse and calculate complex mathematical expressions without unsafe eval
